meta.note: averaged perceptron, pure Python; weights pruned and quantised; synthetic data only

lexicon.note: Cues of BEHAVIOUR-SPEC 1.4-1.6 in natural spelling; normalise at load with normalize.normalize. neg_ok = the negator is part of the cue (never suppressed). candidate_only = very common cues the model and the rate rules decide (spec 1.2). ask also fires on any clause ending in ? or the Arabic question mark. No scripture or verse anywhere: only everyday words.

small.longest_match_note: شوي شوي is calm, not small

up.multi_cue_rule: the last cue of the phrase carries the anchor

greet.rule: first agent message only, within the first 40 characters

wave.rule: not in the first message; at most once per 60 s

bye.rule: plain see you is not a cue

H_Shake.rule: a standalone no only; negated affirmations also give H_Shake
